systems.system: Planned link between the NIP database and the civil registry

note: The passages describe government strategy as of 2019 for a foundational ID system assigning a lifetime NIP with biometric de-duplication, seeded from electoral and social registries; over time its database 'would' interoperate with the digitized civil registry database so that each NIP links to a birth record and NIPs can be generated at birth. All conditional and future; the civil registry database is named without saying how records are made, so no fact.
